Package jzelda.entities

Class Entity

java.lang.Object
jzelda.entities.Entity
Direct Known Subclasses:
Enemy, Player, Projectile
public abstract class Entity extends Object
Base class for all active objects in the model world. It stores only logical state; rendering is performed by the view.
